task.title: Agent briefs
task.description: A brief flag on the work queue command that writes a self-contained Markdown brief for one queue item: the task, the gate and its criteria, the junction references, the requirement texts and the commit the agent makes when done. A person or a harness pastes the brief into an agent's session.

supplier.title: tabloio
supplier.description: The Tableaux command-line front end. Its output side renders every view in a textual format for static media, Markdown or Unicode text, and never changes project state; its input side operates the method through Git commits. This project is one subproject of the Tableaux tooling plan in the tableaux repository, whose task for it delegates every gate after defined here. It inherits that plan's review policy: agents contribute at every gate, each on the model family the junction names, and the owner reviews mockups, designs, validation and releases.
